/*commonWmReApproval.selectapprovalWmReListPop*/
SELECT A.DOC_NAME , (SELECT COD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'APPR' AND COD.CODE = A.DOC_NAME) AS DOC_CD , C.BUYER , (SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = C.BUYER) BUYER_NAME , C.PO_NO , C.PO_SEQ , C.BUYER_ITEM_NO , C.DESCRIPTION , C.SPECIFICATION , C.MAKER_NAME , C.UNIT_MEASURE , C.ITEM_QTY , C.UNIT_PRICE , C.ITEM_AMT , B.STATUS ,(SELECT COD.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 COD WHERE COD.TYPE ='WM09' AND COD.CODE = B.STATUS) STATUS_NM , NVL(B.ERR_MSG,' ') AS ERR_MSG , B.STATUS , A.TARGET AS GW_NO , D.AGENT , (SELECT CMPY.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY CMPY WHERE CMPY.COM_CODE = D.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME , F.MAKER_PART_NO FROM ICOMTRGW A, KEPMGPDT B , ICOMPODT C, ICOMPOHD D, ICOMCMPY E, ICOMBYIT F WHERE A.KEY_2 = B.BUYER AND A.KEY_1 = B.PM_NO AND B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = C.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = C.PO_SEQ AND C.BUYER = D.BUYER AND C.PO_NO = D.PO_NO AND C.BUYER = E.COM_CODE AND E.BYCA_COMORG_CODE = F.BUYER AND C.BUYER_ITEM_NO = F.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.COM_CODE = #{COMPANY} AND A.KEY_1 = #{DOCU_NO}
